tool_limitations.limitation: Copies legacy `Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs` (including sub-project `Tasks/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs`) into the live tree. The SDK-style WinUI csproj auto-generates the same assembly attributes, so the copied file yields CS0579 duplicate-attribute errors.

doc_errors.wrong: Shows bare `DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(...)` as if `DispatcherQueue` is always in scope and omits the `using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;` directive.
doc_errors.correct: In a non-Page/non-DependencyObject helper class `DispatcherQueue` is neither an inherited member nor auto-imported; the class needs `using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;` and must receive the queue (ctor injection) or call `DispatcherQueue.GetForCurrentThread()`.

special_apis.special_handling: Instance member only on DependencyObject/Page. Plain helper classes (e.g. DeviceWatcherHelper) must have `using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;` and receive/fetch a DispatcherQueue rather than referencing `Dispatcher`/`DispatcherQueue` directly.

errors_encountered.error: CS0246: The type or namespace name 'DispatcherQueue' could not be found (DeviceWatcherHelper.cs 21,13 and 73,9)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Helper class replaced Dispatcher.RunAsync with DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue but had no `using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;` and no DispatcherQueue in scope (it is not a Page).
errors_encountered.fix: Added `using Microsoft.UI.Dispatching;`, added a `DispatcherQueue dispatcherQueue` field + constructor parameter, and passed `DispatcherQueue` from each Page (`new DeviceWatcherHelper(resultCollection, DispatcherQueue)`).

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 'DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType' + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter...' + WMC9999 internal error (MainPage.xaml 24/25)
errors_encountered.root_cause: CASCADE from the CS0246 C# compile failure: when the C# fails to compile, MarkupCompilePass2 gets no LocalAssembly, so every project-local x:Bind DataType (here `local:Scenario`) fails to resolve. MainPage.xaml already had a correct `x:DataType="local:Scenario"` and was never re-edited (confirmed: no MainPage.xaml edit between failed build 5896 and success 6807).
errors_encountered.fix: None needed for the XAML. Once the CS0246 errors were fixed and the C# compiled, all WMC errors disappeared.
